$comment: External published results (third-party, engine-project and vendor benchmarks), evidence class "external". Not measured by this console, not KServe measurements, and never used for ranking, sustainable throughput, C_max, Δ vs best, champions, frontier or Compare deltas. Generated by scripts/import-external.ts; do not edit by hand.

flags.agentic-trace-workload: multi-turn agentic trace replay with variable ISL/OSL
flags.artifact-or-revision-differs: published checkpoint or revision differs from, or cannot be tied to, the catalog artifact
flags.batch-size-not-concurrency: levels are offline batch sizes, not online concurrency
flags.cached-input-in-total: total throughput counts prefix-cache-hit input tokens (InferenceX tput_per_gpu)
flags.custom-image-tag: engine is a named non-release image or custom build
flags.different-checkpoint: published checkpoint differs from, or cannot be tied to, the catalog artifact
flags.engine-not-vllm-sglang: engine is neither vLLM nor SGLang
flags.engine-version-not-stated: the source states no engine build identity
flags.from-prior-dataset: regrouped from an earlier point dataset
flags.gpu-type-unstated: GPU type not stated by the source
flags.hardware-mismatch: GPU type is not B300 (the console target)
flags.kv-offload: KV cache offload to host memory/storage enabled on at least one level
flags.kv-offload-host-dram: KV cache offloaded to host memory
flags.low-provenance: configuration, checkpoint or harness only partly stated by the source
flags.multi-node: deployment spans more than one node
flags.multi-replica: figure aggregates more than one serving replica
flags.nightly-build: engine is a nightly/dev/main/source-tree/fork build, not a stable release
flags.not-a-throughput-measurement: the published figure is not a throughput measurement (e.g. memory capacity)
flags.orchestrated-by-dynamo: vLLM/SGLang workers behind NVIDIA Dynamo, not a KServe-equivalent deployment
flags.orchestrated-or-other-engine: served through an orchestrator or an engine other than vLLM/SGLang
flags.other-hardware: GPU outside B300/GB300/B200/GB200/H200 or not stated
flags.pd-disaggregated: prefill/decode disaggregated; per-GPU denominators differ by metric
flags.per-level-config-varies: shape/offload/GPU count differs between levels of the curve
flags.pre-release-engine-build: engine is a nightly, dev or release-candidate build, not a stable release
flags.relative-only: the source publishes a relative figure only (speedup), not an absolute rate
flags.request-failures: the source reports failed or empty requests at one or more levels
flags.revision-not-pinned: checkpoint revision not stated or not recoverable
flags.single-level: only one load level published for this exact configuration (not a sweep)
flags.superseded-run: historical run superseded on the publisher dashboard
flags.synthetic-acceptance: speculative acceptance forced/simulated (InferenceX golden AL, SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN); not real-prompt acceptance
flags.unmerged-pr-build: measured on a PR branch (measured commit may be unstated)
flags.unverified-extraction: extracted but not in the verifier-checked set

conventions.derived: Metric names ending '(derived)' are computed (aggregate ÷ GPU count) and noted 'derived: ÷ N GPUs'; all others are as published.
conventions.kserve: Sources use their own serving stacks; none measures a KServe InferenceService. Engine/args transfer to a KServe ServingRuntime is an assumption.

versionClasses.stable: existing stable release tag; canonical = tag, releaseDate = GitHub release date, availableFrom = earliest of GitHub release and PyPI upload
versionClasses.nightly-or-commit: nightly image, main/branch@sha, PR branch/head, or dev source build without a named non-release image tag; commits[] resolved against the upstream repo
versionClasses.custom-tag: named non-release image tag (model-specific project image, vendor or local build) or a release that was patched/overlaid/forked; baseRelease kept when stated
versionClasses.not-stated: the source states no build identity (day-0 build, floating latest/main, not captured)
versionClasses.invalid: no such release, or a release implausible for the model
